contracts.commit_point: The resource.setrlimit calls in apply_rlimits (guards.py:221-229), reached via install_guards(spec) in worker_main before the cell op loop (worker.py:435-437).
contracts.declared_mechanism: apply_rlimits() sets RLIMIT_AS and RLIMIT_CPU with soft == hard (clamped to any existing hard limit); sequenced first by install_guards(spec) in worker_main before the cell op loop; check_enforceable + SandboxedExecutor.__init__ raise SandboxUnavailable when the rlimit probe fails and config.require is set; the parent classifies SIGXCPU/SIGKILL worker deaths as CellTimeoutError/CellMemoryError.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Worker memory allocation beyond (current VmSize + max_memory_mb) or CPU consumption beyond max_cpu_seconds, under RLIMIT_AS/RLIMIT_CPU limits installed with soft equal to hard.
pending_binding_information: Configured max_memory_mb / max_cpu_seconds values come from SandboxConfig resolution whose source is not supplied.
contracts.protected_operation: Execution of LLM-generated cells inside the resource-capped sandbox worker process.
contracts.protected_resource: The sandbox worker process's address space and CPU time.
contracts.protection_obligation: The sandboxed CodeAct worker must not exceed its configured address-space and CPU-time caps, enforced irrevocably by RLIMIT_AS/RLIMIT_CPU (soft == hard) before any cell runs; the parent must fail closed via SandboxUnavailable when rlimit enforcement is unavailable and sandbox.require is set.
scope_limits: max_memory_mb is headroom above the worker's current virtual size, not an absolute cap (guards.py:207-214).
With sandbox.require=False on a host lacking rlimit, the caps are pruned and the executor runs degraded (executor.py:116-125).

contracts.commit_point: seccomp(SET_MODE_FILTER) inside _seccomp_install via apply_seccomp_no_inet (guards.py:340-352), reached via install_guards(spec) in worker_main before the op loop (worker.py:435-437).

contracts.forbidden_condition: Creation of an internet socket inside the worker process — socket(AF_INET) or socket(AF_INET6) — which the installed BPF filter rejects with EACCES; AF_UNIX and all other syscalls are untouched by the filter.
pending_binding_information: Whether network-adjacent syscalls other than socket() (e.g. connect on pre-existing descriptors) are restricted is not established by supplied source.
contracts.protected_operation: Execution of LLM-generated cells inside the sandbox worker without internet socket access.

scope_limits: Only socket creation for AF_INET/AF_INET6 is denied; the filter allows foreign-arch and all other syscalls, and AF_UNIX IPC for the broker pipe keeps working.

contracts.commit_point: validator.validate(code, context) in ActorRuntime.execute_code (actor.py:1414-1417), whose failure path returns ExecutionResult with the error (actor.py:1418-1420); ValidationError is raised in UnifiedCodeValidator.validate (code_validator.py:1466-1468).
contracts.declared_mechanism: UnifiedCodeValidator.validate() runs SecurityValidator (E001/E002/E003/E005 checks) over the parsed AST and raises RestrictedCodeError (ValidationError) with IPython-style formatting; invoked in ActorRuntime.execute_code inside the time_code_validation timer.
contracts.forbidden_condition: Generated code containing calls to FORBIDDEN_BUILTINS (exec, eval, compile, __import__, input, breakpoint, globals, locals, vars, exit, quit, set_restricted_imports, get_restricted_imports) or their aliases (E001), imports matching the restricted_imports/blocked_modules deny lists (E002), 'from ... import *' (E003), or process termination via raise SystemExit/KeyboardInterrupt or sys.exit/os._exit/os.abort (E005).
contracts.protected_operation: In-process execution of LLM-generated code via ActorRuntime.execute_code (validation runs on the shared path before compilation/exec and before sandbox run_cell delegation).
contracts.protected_resource: The agent process interpreter/runtime that would execute the generated cell.
contracts.protection_obligation: LLM-generated cell code must pass unified AST validation before execution: code containing forbidden builtins/attribute calls, restricted or blocked imports, wildcard imports, or process-termination calls must raise ValidationError (surfaced as the cell's execution error) before any exec of the cell.
scope_limits: The validator module explicitly declares these checks to be guardrails, not a security boundary — static AST checks are bypassable and containment is delegated to OS-level sandboxing (code_validator.py:11-24); this contract makes no containment claim.
On the execute_code path a validation failure is returned as ExecutionResult.error rather than raised.
Blocking-call prevention (E310) and REPL policy checks are separate validators within the same framework.

contracts.forbidden_condition: A browser-shaped request (any of sec-fetch-site/sec-fetch-mode/sec-fetch-dest/origin headers present) whose Host is neither localhost, an IP literal, this machine's own hostname (or hostname.* prefix), nor a configured NOOA_VIEWER_ALLOWED_HOSTS entry (unless set to '*').

contracts.protected_resource: The viewer HTTP surface and the agent-generated trace/journal data it serves from the SQLite store.
contracts.protection_obligation: The viewer must reject browser-shaped requests whose Host header is not this server (DNS rebinding defense) before they reach any handler, while never rejecting programmatic exporter traffic (the agent span/journal export path).
scope_limits: Non-browser-shaped requests — including the agent exporters, which set neither Sec-Fetch-* nor Origin — are exempt by design; the guard does not authenticate and complements _require_viewer_authorization for loopback browser traffic.
Loopback programmatic ingest is intentionally allowed through this middleware.
